Beat 1: **She made her TV debut at five months old, then survived cancer and MS to win comedy's highest praise.**

Beat 2: Born November 25, 1971, Christina Applegate turns 55 today, originating from Hollywood, California.

Beat 3: Raised by a single mother in Los Angeles, she fought past early sitcom typecasting as a ditzy blonde.

Beat 4: Winning an Emmy on Friends and stealing Anchorman opposite Will Ferrell proved her razor-sharp comic range.

Beat 5: Starring in Married... with Children, Samantha Who?, and Dead to Me made her a three-decade TV icon.

Beat 6: Surviving breast cancer in 2008 and a devastating multiple sclerosis diagnosis in 2021, she refused to quit.

Beat 7: Receiving a Hollywood Walk of Fame star and standing ovation at the Emmys, her courage inspires millions.

Beat 8: **Was Kelly Bundy, Veronica Corningstone in Anchorman, or Jen Harding in Dead to Me her best role?**
posts.comment:
**The secret behind Hollywood's bravest comedy icon:**
• Made her television debut at five months old alongside her mother in a soap opera and a Playtex commercial.
• Won a Primetime Emmy Award for playing Rachel Green's sister Amy on Friends.
• Received seven total Primetime Emmy nominations across Friends, Samantha Who?, and Dead to Me.

Which Christina Applegate role do you love most: Kelly Bundy, Veronica Corningstone, or Jen Harding?
posts.reel_script: Before receiving a tearful standing ovation at the Emmy Awards, a baby in Hollywood made her television debut at just five months old. Fighting past sitcom typecasting as Kelly Bundy to steal Anchorman and anchor Dead to Me, she bravely survived breast cancer and multiple sclerosis while keeping the world laughing. Her courage is extraordinary. Happy birthday! Which of her iconic roles is your favorite?
